reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse an OPEN statement that opens a report file (an FD with a REPORT clause) under the INPUT phrase (with or without REVERSED or NO REWIND) or the I-O phrase, in any position of a multi-phrase OPEN, and accept OPEN OUTPUT [WITH NO REWIND] and OPEN EXTEND of it, including an OPEN that also opens another file under INPUT.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel picks only the FORMAT-clause citation text of the I-O screen; the report-file INPUT/I-O arm reads no edition

reader.edition-search: Read BindOpen and CheckOpenModeForFile; the report-file arm (file.IsReportFile && mode is Input or IO -> COBOL2371) has no DialectLevel, CobolVersion or ConstructRegistry test. BindOpen resolves with admitsReportFile: true, so ScreenReportFileReference is not asked for OPEN.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb318 covers OPEN INPUT of a report file and pb1171 the legal OUTPUT/CLOSE references; I-O, INPUT REVERSED, a report file in the second phrase of a multi-phrase OPEN, OUTPUT WITH NO REWIND and EXTEND are not exercised

probes.printed: COBOL2371 OPEN INPUT 'PRT' - a report file shall not be opened INPUT or I-O
COBOL2371 OPEN INPUT 'PRT' (INPUT ... REVERSED, a 1985-only phrase)
COBOL2371 OPEN INPUT 'PRT' (OPEN OUTPUT OTH INPUT PRT)
DONE (OPEN OUTPUT, INITIATE, GENERATE, TERMINATE, CLOSE)
DONE; the file holds 'D1' twice (OPEN OUTPUT then OPEN EXTEND appends, GR4)
probes.expected: accepted; EXTEND adds to the file

probes.printed: DONE (OPEN OUTPUT PRT WITH NO REWIND)

probes.expected: accepted: only the report file's phrase is restricted

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.5.3 SR1  (4.5.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1
OK  §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR4  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: The per-file mode screen runs for every openFileSpec of every mode group, so a report file is refused under INPUT or I-O wherever it is written. The diagnostic cites only §2023:14.9.27.3 SR1 at --std 85 (citation blemish).

refuter.evidence: Attack on the reading: SR1 says 'The OPEN statement for a report file must contain only the OUTPUT phrase or the EXTEND phrase', which could be read as the whole statement; but §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR17 makes a multi-file OPEN equal to a separate OPEN per file, so the per-file reading (reader's o6 accepted) stands. Read StatementValidation.cs#CheckOpenModeForFile: report-file arm reads no edition (DialectLevel there selects only the FORMAT-clause citation). Probes: r12 (OPEN INPUT OTH PRT WITH NO REWIND, report file second in an INPUT phrase with the 1985 NO REWIND form) -> COBOL2371 for PRT; r13 (FD REPORTS ARE R1 R2 and FD REPORT R3: OPEN OUTPUT PRT EXTEND PR2 accepted, then OPEN EXTEND PRT I-O PR2) -> COBOL2371 only for I-O PR2. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.5.3 SR1; OK §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR17 'as if a separate OPEN statement had been written for each file-name'.
